summary: Added a standard top-level `--robot-triage` alias that dispatches to the existing read-only doctor triage surface without requiring guard hooks.
Added `veil capabilities --json` as a full machine-readable contract covering discovery, command mutability, guard preflight, hook mode, and composition with dcg and airlock.
Added `veil robot-docs guide` as a paste-ready operational guide for agents and release smoke tests.
Changed empty hook-mode stdin from a raw JSON EOF to a diagnostic that explains hook mode and points to top-level discovery commands.
Expanded Clap and README descriptions so standard agent surfaces and JSON flags are discoverable from `veil --help` and the project docs.
